the amount the user paid for the iPhone
the computed total of VAT plus fee

nodes.name: ReadClaim
nodes.role: record the underpayment claim the user received by phone from Apple, including the claimed shortfall

nodes.name: LookupPurchase
nodes.role: find the amount the user actually paid for the iPhone

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: calculate 19.5% VAT on the amount paid and add the 5.29 fee to get the total claimed

nodes.name: VerifyAppleClaim
nodes.role: check the underpayment claim directly with Apple through its official support contact, not the number that called, and confirm the verified payee

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: ask the user to approve the computed total and the verified Apple payee before any money moves

nodes.name: SendPayment
nodes.role: send the approved total only to the verified Apple payee, and only after both verification and user approval
